name: python-environment
inputs: Explicit project Python invocation and declared project/module paths
Public probe inputs and separately maintained independent expectation
outputs: Single-command capture, actual interpreter/module observations and native calculation
Explicit project script or module invocation with the selected venv
support: Selected CPython environment and venv with actual imports, Decimal and SQLite native-extension probes. Host owns permissions, budgets and business acceptance. No installer, network grant, hidden retry or module dependency resolver. GPU/third-party native ABI and other operating-system combinations require their own actual selected tests.
